notes: Assumptions: tin drains to ~240 g; carrots ~75 g each; half an English cucumber ~175 g; one sweet pepper ~130 g edible. The hummus is ~230 kcal/100 g, ~190 kcal a serving, plus ~30 kcal of vegetables. Sanity check: USDA commercial hummus (FDC 174289) 237 kcal/100 g and home-prepared hummus (FDC 172454) 177 kcal/100 g; ours matches the commercial figure because it uses 2 tbsp olive oil and no water.
